errata: The original manual incorrectly describes basic Slow as reducing speed to 25%; the actual reduction is 25%.
The original manual describes an extra 20% reduction for advanced Curse; actual base damage is minimum minus one, bounded at one.
Fire-school immunity includes Magic Arrow even if the hero uses mastery in a different school.
Death Ripple affects non-living creatures too; only undead and independently immune targets are excluded.
Advanced Forgetfulness is already a mass spell in classic Complete, unlike the HotA fix.
